mechanism: Replace all Attention and MLP parameters by the public anchor, then fit only the last MLP output to task-class response targets with the original mean and variance. Keep all other expert parameters and the classifier head unchanged.
fitting: One closed-form ridge fit, 1024 unlabeled MNIST training images; original expert pre-LayerNorm CLS responses are available only to the defender. No gradients or optimizer.
scope: The class-difference constraint has rank at most 9. The variance-preserving target also changes the class-null component, so the parameter update is not claimed to have rank 9. Exact geometry is a per-calibration-input construction, not a generalization guarantee.
early_stop: Reject after utility loss above 0.5 pp; no attacks or test evaluation then. Otherwise compare fixed recovery groups including public last-output delta scaling by 2. Only survivors may proceed to functional recovery and full official test.
novelty: Task-response fitting, distillation and closed-form reconstruction are known operations. This tests function relocation against support replacement; no novelty or security claim.
evaluation: New MNIST training confirmation excludes the listed old subsets and new calibration; SVHN uses the already inspected development subset. Not held out from original expert training or official test.
